name: prompt_cache_evolve
title: Evolutionary Prompt Cache Prefix Canonicalization & Reordering
problem_description: Given multi-turn enterprise agent prompts containing interleaved static system instructions, tool schemas, multi-line JSON payloads, RAG context, and volatile per-turn tokens (ISO-8601 timestamps, UUIDs/request IDs, user emails, unsorted JSON keys, mixed JSON objects with both static schemas and volatile fields, and trailing whitespace variance), evolve propose_cache_friendly_rewrite(prompt: str) -> dict[str, Any] to maximize the shared byte-identical cached prefix across consecutive turns while preserving 100% of semantic content.
initial_program_description: Extracts propose_cache_friendly_rewrite and its volatile-span detectors from vibelift/prompt_xray.py (lines 243-281), which moves volatile lines to a trailing dynamic section and sorts single-line JSON dicts.
evolve_block_description: The EVOLVE-BLOCK wraps propose_cache_friendly_rewrite(prompt: str) -> dict[str, Any] and its helper functions for multi-line JSON canonicalization, mixed static/volatile JSON object partitioning, and deterministic static prefix assembly.
constraints: Lossless invariant: all non-whitespace tokens and JSON key-value pairs from the input prompt must be preserved in rewritten_prompt
Deterministic invariant: calling propose_cache_friendly_rewrite twice on the same input must be idempotent
